text: Placement hints give compass directions ('Open ground lies about 190 to the south-west') but nothing on screen shows which way is north/south: no compass, no map. Following the hint by trial and error took 3 tries; hint direction flipped from south-east to south-west after one move.

Standing at my new settlement's well, the big floating settlement label ('0 here, 1/8 residents') renders across the top of the screen behind the Objective toast and chronicle panel, cut off at the screen edge and hard to read.

First world event (tick 19753: 'A bountiful harvest came in across Northernwood...') only appeared as one chronicle line and was pushed out of the 5-line recent-chronicle panel within ~a minute by a burst of NationRaid lines (13 raids logged at the same tick 17001, more at night). A player would never notice a world event happened; it has no distinct styling from raids/relations.
